verdict.rationale: Anthropic's product docs explicitly state Claude Code 'maps and explains entire codebases in a few seconds' using 'agentic search' so users don't need to manually select context files, directly matching the story. Community evidence corroborates it handling multi-file, multi-language codebases well in practice, though no independent benchmark specifically tests the 'map and explain unfamiliar codebase' claim. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the specific codebase-mapping claim and more detail on how agentic search scales on very large/unfamiliar repos.
